A young woman in glasses and red lipstick and a fair-skinned man in a suit stand in a minimalist Mexican apartment kitchen.

A young woman with light-toned skin, light blue eyes, and long, wavy, platinum blonde hair parted slightly off-center wears round, thin-rimmed glasses and bright red lipstick. A small mole is visible on her left cheek near her nose. She is adorned with a delicate gold necklace featuring a small, dark red heart pendant and a thin, dark red choker. She is wearing a black top with a hint of red fabric underneath. Nearby stands a fair-skinned man with dark brown hair styled with longer sides and short, neat bangs, and a sparse goatee. He wears black-framed rectangular glasses and is dressed in a light blue collared shirt under a light-colored suit jacket. A microphone on a light gray or silver stand with a round metallic head is partially visible to the right of the man. The setting is a minimalist kitchen in a Mexican apartment.
